text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Air Shakur and I are discussing
her
schedule going forward in my office.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
To make a long story short, things're
gonna get
even tougher from here on
out.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I need to be even more efficient than
before or
else it's game over.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll get Parcae to simulate a training
program
that'll eliminate inefficiency.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to look at my past notes to help
organize
my thoughts. I go to open my
desk drawer, and
when I do...
choice_data_list: わかった

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Flutter.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey, you dropped somethin'.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What do I find on the floor but the hot
spring
vacation coupon I won some time
ago?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You still haven't used that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The real reason is because I completely
forgot
about it. I'd originally entered the
raffle, hoping
to give the coupon to Air
Shakur, but she didn't
want it, so it's
been collecting dust all this time.
choice_data_list: タイミングがなくて……

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You don't want it?
choice_data_list: シャカール、行かないよな？
シャカール、行かないよね？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Considering how tense Air Shakur has
been, I
don't think it'd be in good taste
to go off and
relax on my own.
choice_data_list: しばらく忙しそうだから

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, why don't we just go now before
things start
to ramp up?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
We go now, get it over with, and come
back.
Forget the whole overnight stay
part, though. I'm
not havin' any of that.
choice_data_list: え？

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That should put you at ease, right?
Then, get
your things so we can get
goin'.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh. This place isn't too shabby.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? Yeah, sure...
choice_data_list: 温泉、貸し切りのところ使ってくれ
温泉、貸し切りのところ使ってね

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Meh.
choice_data_list: ……もしかして入らない気だった？

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well. I guess if no one else'll be around
since you
reserved it and everything...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: All right. I'll see you later.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Whoa!
choice_data_list: さっぱりした？

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What, you're done already?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's only half the truth. The main
reason was
because I didn't want Air
Shakur to wait on me,
but I don't bring
that part up.
choice_data_list: 長いと湯あたりしちゃうから

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, okay.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sure.
choice_data_list: 帰ろうか

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We head back to the station. The breeze
is lovely
as it blows past us and cools our
warm bodies
down.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Yup.
choice_data_list: ついてきてくれてありがとう

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Well... I did agree to come.
choice_data_list: この感謝は受け取ってくれるんだ

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: For your sake.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I don't believe in exceptions or outliers. I
keep
our relationship at the bare
minimum.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But this was also necessary in order to
hit the
reset button on us.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
These past three years've been crazy
long.
choice_data_list: リセット？

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll admit our relationship's changed
since we first
started workin' together.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: To be honest, I even feel like I get you sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Not like that's actually possible, though.
I'm not
here to understand anyone or to
be understood.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But if we're gonna keep workin'
together, we
gotta ditch all the
preconceived notions we've
got about
each other.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'm what?
choice_data_list: 君は……
貴方は……

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: やっぱり、真面目な子だな
やっぱり、真面目な子だね

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I thought I told you to quit it with that
kinda
stuff.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: But what?
choice_data_list: わかった、でも……

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: また努力してもいいだろう？
また努力してもいいでしょう？

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Not like you'd stop even if I told you
to...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
C'mon. We're gonna miss the train at this
rate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Air Shakur and I have
formed an
irreplaceable bond during this
time together.
